input.question: Who is the artist of the "Classic Christmas" album?

documents.text: Classic Christmas (Joe McElderry album) Classic Christmas is the third studio album and first Christmas album by the British singer Joe McElderry. It was released on 25 November 2011. It is his second album released under Decca Records. Before the album's official announcement, it was available to pre-order from Play.com, Amazon.co.uk and HMV.com. On 6 October, McElderry announced that he was working on the album on Twitter and later on his official website.
